name: lxst_audio
description: LXST voice capture/codec path vendored from pyxis (GPL-3.0). Hybrid build uses I2SCapture + Codec2Wrapper + filters + ring buffers + I2SPlayback. lxst_audio.cpp (full-duplex orchestrator, depends on pyxis's Tone) stays excluded. i2s_playback.cpp was excluded under D4 (fought meshpunk's boot-installed I2S_NUM_0 driver); D12 (docs/hybrid/HYBRID_PLAN.md) supersedes that for call duration only — PyxisCall.cpp swaps I2S0 to this file's native-8k driver via sound.cpp's new acquire/restore API and swaps the mixer back at every call end. Pins come from the local Hardware/TDeck/Config.h shim.
